chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halbi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when he performed the Hajj of Al-Islam, set out when four days remained from Dhu al-Qadah until he arrived at Al-Shajara, so he prayed there. Then he led his mount until he arrived at Al-Bayda', so he entered into Ihram from there and proclaimed the Hajj, and drove along one hundred camels. And the people all entered into Ihram with the Hajj, not intending an Umrah, nor knowing what Al-Mut'ah was. Until when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) arrived in Mecca, he circumambulated the House, and the people circumambulated with him.

Then he prayed two cycles near the Maqam (Station of Ibrahim), and kissed the Stone, then said: 'I begin with what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, began with.' So he went to Al-Safa and began with it. Then he circumambulated between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa seven times. So when he had completed his circumambulation at Al-Marwa, he stood as a preacher.

So he ordered them to release themselves (from Ihram) and make it an Umrah, and it is something which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, had commanded. So the people released themselves, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Had I faced from my matter what I managed, I would have done as I commanded you.' And he did not have the ability to release himself due to the sacrificial animal which was with him. Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'And do not shave your heads until the offering reaches its destination.'

So Suraqah ibn Malik ibn Ju'sham said, 'O Messenger of Allah! Teach us as if we were created today. What is your view of this which you ordered us with? Is it for this year of ours, or for every year?' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'No, but it is for ever and ever.' And indeed a man stood up and said, 'O Messenger of Allah! We go out as pilgrims and our heads are dripping.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'You will never believe in this, ever!'

He said: And Ali (peace be upon him) came from Yemen until he arrived for the Hajj. So he found Fatima (peace be upon her) had released herself, and he found the scent of perfume. So he went to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to inquire. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'O Ali! With what did you proclaim?' He said: 'I proclaimed with what the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) proclaimed.' He said: 'Do not release yourself, you are a participant in the sacrifice.' So he made him a participant in the sacrifice and assigned thirty-seven to him, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sacrificed sixty-three, which he sacrificed with his own hand.

Then he took a piece from each camel and put it in one pot. Then he ordered it to be cooked, so it was cooked. So he ate from it and sipped from the soup, and said: 'We have eaten from it now all together. And Al-Mut'ah is better than the Qarin (who combines Hajj and Umrah) who drives the offering, and better than the Mufrid (who performs Hajj alone).'

He said: And I asked him, 'Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) enter into Ihram at night or during the day?' He said: 'During the day.' I said, 'At which time?' He said: 'At the Dhuhr prayer.'

key_terms.إِحْرَام: State of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.الْبَيْدَاء: A location near Mecca where the Prophet entered Ihram
key_terms.الْحَاجُّ الْمُفْرِد: One who performs Hajj alone, separate from Umrah
key_terms.الْقَارِن: One who combines Hajj and Umrah with a single Ihram
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةُ: Hajj al-Mut'ah, combining Umrah and Hajj with a single Ihram
key_terms.الْهَدْي: Sacrificial animals brought by the pilgrim

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Hajj al-Mut'ah and other forms of Hajj according to the Prophet's practice?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the Farewell Pilgrimage, highlighting the Prophet's (saww) establishment of Hajj al-Mut'ah by converting his initial intention to Umrah, a practice distinct from the Mufrid and Qarin forms. It underscores the theological basis for his delayed release from Ihram due to the sacrificial animals (had'y) and confirms the specific timing of his entry into Ihram at Dhuhr. The narration also records the Prophet's definitive ruling that this form of Hajj is perpetual, not limited to that year alone.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, when he<sup>saww</sup> performed Hajj, the Hajj of Al-Islam, went out during where there remained four days from Zil-Qadah until he<sup>saww</sup> came over to Al-Shajara. So he<sup>saww</sup> Prayed by it, then sat upon his<sup>saww</sup> ride until he<sup>saww</sup> came to Al-Bayda. So he<sup>saww</sup> wore the Ihram from it, and commenced with the Hajj, and ushered one hundred camels. And the people, all of them, wore their Ihrams with the Hajj, not intending an Umra, nor knowing what the Mut’a (of Hajj) was, until when Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> set foot in Makkah, he<sup>saww</sup> circumambulated by the House, then the people circumambulated along with him<sup>saww</sup>.

Then he<sup>saww</sup> Prayed two Cycles by the Standing Place (of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>, and kissed the (Black) Stone, then said: ‘Begin with what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Began with’. So he<sup>saww</sup> came over to Al-Saffa and began with it. Then he<sup>saww</sup> circumambulated between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, seven (times). So when he<sup>saww</sup> had completed his<sup>saww</sup> circumambulations at Al-Marwa, he<sup>saww</sup> stood preaching.

So hesaww ordered them that they should free (themselves from the Ihram), and make it to be an Umra, and it is something which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic had Commanded with. So the people freed (themselves from the Ihram), and Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Had Isaww faced from mysaww matters what Isaww managed, Isaww would have done the like of what Isaww am ordering you all for’, and hesaww did not have the leeway that hesaww frees (from hissaww Ihram) due to the reason of the sacrificial animal which were with himazwj. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [2:196] and do not shave your heads until the offering reaches its destination.

So, Suraqat Bin Malik Bin Ju’sham said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! Teach us as if we were Created today. What is your<sup>saww</sup> view of this which you<sup>saww</sup> are ordering us with. Is it for this year of ours, or for every year?’ So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘No, but it is for ever and ever’. And a man stood up, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! We came out as Pilgrims and our heads are dripping’. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘You will never believe in this, ever!’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Ali<sup>asws</sup> came back from Al-Yemen until fulfilled the Hajj. So he<sup>asws</sup> found Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup> having had freed (from wearing the Ihram), and found aromatic fragrance. So he<sup>asws</sup> went to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> to follow up. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! With which thing have you<sup>asws</sup> welcomed (the Hajj)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> welcomed with the welcoming of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not free (from the Ihram), for you<sup>asws</sup> are a participant in the sacrifice’, and he<sup>saww</sup> made thirty-seven to be for him<sup>asws</sup>, and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> sacrificed sixty-three, which he<sup>saww</sup> sacrificed with his<sup>saww</sup> own hands.

Then he<sup>saww</sup> grabbed a piece from each camel to be in one pot. Then he<sup>saww</sup> ordered with it, so it was cooked. So he<sup>saww</sup> ate from it and sipped from the soup, and said: ‘We<sup>saww</sup> have eaten from it now together, and the Mut’a (of the Hajj) is better than pairing the usherer, and better than the individual Hajj’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Did Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> wear the Ihram at night or at daytime?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Daytime’. I said, ‘Which time?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Al-Zohr Prayer’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that when the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, performed al- Hajjata al-Islam, he left al-Madinah when only four days from the month of Dhu al-Qa‘dah remained.

When he (the Messenger of Allah) arrived at al-Shajarah, he performed Salat (prayer) then drove his stumper until he arrived in al-Bayda’, he then assumed the state of Ihram and recited Talbiyah for al- Hajj. He (the Messenger of Allah) drove one hundred camels and all the people also assumed the state of Ihram for al-Hajj. They did not have the intention for al-‘Umrah and did not know what al-Mut‘ah was. When the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, arrived in Makkah he performed Tawaf around the House. People also performed Tawaf along with him.

He (the Messenger of Allah) then performed two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) near the station of Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then touched the Black Stone. He (the Messenger of Allah) then said, T commence with what Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has commenced. He then went to al-Safa’ to commence walking. He (the Messenger of Allah) then performed Tawaf between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah seven times. When he (the Messenger of Allah) completed his Tawaf at al-Marwah, he (the Messenger of Allah) then stood there for a speech.

He (the Messenger of Allah) commanded them to come out of the state of Ihram and make it an al-‘Umrah. It is something that Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has commanded to do. People came out of the state of Ihram and the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, Tf I will have a chance in future I will not go back. I will do as I have commanded you to do. He (the Messenger of Allah) was not able to come out of the state of Ihram because of the offering animals, which were with him (the Messenger of Allah). Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, says, ‘Do not shave your heads until the offering animals reach their designated places.’

Suraqah ibn Malik ibn Jush‘am al-Kinaniy said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, teach us just as we are created today. What you have commanded us to do this year is it just for this year or it will be as such every year?’ The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘It is forever.’ A man stood up and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah is it that we will come to perform al-Hajj and water will drip from our heads?’ (He thereby meant engagement in sexual activities). The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘You will never believe in it (al-Mut‘ah of al-Hajj). He (the Imam) said that Ali ‘Alayhi al-Salam, arrived from Yeman to perform al-Hajj, he found Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, who had come out of the state of Ihram, and he sensed perfumes. He (the Imam) went to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, for a fatwa. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, asked, ‘What kind of intention did you have?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘I made my intention like the intention of the Holy prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘You must not come out of the state of Hiram.’

He (the Messenger of Allah) allowed him (the Imam) to share his offering animals and gave him (the Imam) thirty-seven. The Messenger of Allah slaughtered sixty- three. He (the Messenger of Allah) slaughtered them with his own hands.

He (the Messenger of Allah) then from every camel took a certain amount of meat and placed it in one cooking pot. He then commanded to cook, then ate from the meat and sipped from the broth. He (the Messenger of Allah) then said, ‘Now we all have used the meat of our offering for food. Having al-Mut‘ah (advantage of coming out of the state of Ihram after completing the acts of ‘Umrah) is better than al-Qiran Hajj, in which one herds his offering cattle as well as performs Hajj in the form of al-Mufrad Hajj.’

I (the narrator) then asked, ‘Did the Messenger of Allah enter the state of Ihram during the night or during the day?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘It was during the day.’ I then asked, ‘In which hour of the day was it?’ He (the Imam) replied it was at the time of the Salat (prayer) at noontime.’”
